name: Truco Ar
summary: Argentine partnership trick-taking game with 3-card hands, Flor/Envido suit combinations and escalating bluff bets on tricks.
rules_text: Played with 40-card Spanish deck anticlockwise, 4 players in fixed partnerships (2 and 6 player variants exist). Each gets 3 cards. Card trick rank: 1 swords > 1 batons > 7 swords > 7 coins > 3 > 2 > 1 cups/coins > 12 > 11 > 10 > 7 cups/batons > 6 > 5 > 4. Three tricks per hand. Points to 30 wins. Before or during first trick players may bet on Flor (3 of same suit, value sum +20) and Envido (best 2 suited cards sum +20, or high single). Truco bet is on winning 2 of 3 tricks. Bets use reserved Spanish words and have raises: Envido, Real Envido, Falta Envido; Truco, Retruco, Vale Cuatro. Flor must be honestly announced. Envido/Truco can be bluffed. If bet accepted winner scores increased points; if refused refuser gives base points. Conversation and traditional hand signals to partner are allowed.
rating_reason: Specific Truco variant with bluffing, bidding, signals, highly strategic.
